posts.title: You can talk now
posts.description: Half of a pen fight was the whispering. So the desk has a mic: hold to speak, let go to listen, and the room falls silent while you talk. The first tap in the field said the microphone was off. It was. We had switched it off ourselves.

posts.title: The league opens at nine
posts.description: Nobody ever scheduled recess. It happened because everyone was in the same building when the bell went. So Pen Fight now has one hour a night, nine to ten, where every player you meet is a real person and the next match arrives without you asking for it.

posts.title: Every pen is one pen
posts.description: Nothing you own in a game has ever been in anybody else's hands, because nothing you own in a game is a thing. It is a count. So we stopped counting: 2,104 pens came into existence for 154 players, each with its own number and the hands it had already passed through.
